MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink assortments fit my breadboards, jumper wires, PCB boards, and relay purchases because they would help insulate connections in small electronics projects.",
    "Both assorted tubing kits felt relevant because their range of sizes and colors could help me finish and organize different small wires. I would buy only one kit for that need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The large marine heat shrink tube serves a different wiring need from my small circuit supplies; being wire insulation alone does not make it a good fit.",
    "The nut sets require known thread sizes, and I have no current need for either assortment or a hundred identical nuts.",
    "The thermostat, inspection camera, epoxy, cutting wheels, and angle finder each require a specific task that my purchases do not establish. Owning a thermometer, relay, or casters does not mean I currently need those tools."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My practical project purchases seem to have been taken as broad interest in repair and workshop supplies, while I choose supplies for particular jobs.",
    "My thermometer and relay purchases seem to suggest a temperature control project more strongly than they should; they do not establish a need for an outlet thermostat."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases involve small circuit prototyping, so connection size and usefulness with small wires matter more than a general connection to electrical work.",
    "My history spans years and different tasks. An older purchase is a clue to an interest, but it does not establish an active project or an immediate need.",
    "The two tubing assortments address the same need for me. Finding both relevant does not mean I want to purchase both."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in hands-on projects but stretched it beyond small electronics supplies into tools and hardware without a clear current purpose."
}
